description: GOWA - WhatsApp REST API with support for UI, Multi Account, Webhooks, and MCP, and Chatwoot. Built with Golang for efficient memory use.

latest_release.name: v9.10.0
latest_release.body:
## What's New in v9.10.0

📚 **Full History on Pairing, Recoverable Media & Better Chatwoot Sync**

GOWA can now request full WhatsApp history when pairing a new device and ask the paired phone to re-upload expired media. This release also adds private replies to group messages, detailed contact records, caption edits, and richer webhook payloads. Chatwoot gains its own event filter and fixes for poll noise, resolved conversations, and proxy compatibility.

---

## ✨ Features

### Full History on New Pairings ([#855](https://github.com/aldinokemal/go-whatsapp-web-multidevice/pull/855))

- Opt in to requesting full history when pairing a new device. You can set the requested history window and size limit.

### Private Replies, Detailed Contacts & Caption Edits ([#871](https://github.com/aldinokemal/go-whatsapp-web-multidevice/pull/871), [#969](https://github.com/aldinokemal/go-whatsapp-web-multidevice/pull/969), [#918](https://github.com/aldinokemal/go-whatsapp-web-multidevice/pull/918))

- Reply privately to a group message while keeping the quote linked to the original group.
- Use `GET /user/my/contacts/detailed` to retrieve detailed contact records, including available contact names.
- Edit an image or document caption by passing `media_type: image` or `media_type: document` to the message update endpoint.

### Expired Media Recovery ([#959](https://github.com/aldinokemal/go-whatsapp-web-multidevice/pull/959), [#960](https://github.com/aldinokemal/go-whatsapp-web-multidevice/pull/960))

- Ask the paired phone to re-upload expired media for downloads, forwarding that requires a re-upload, and Chatwoot history import. Recovery depends on the phone responding and still having the file.
- During Chatwoot history import, the first unanswered recovery request stops further recovery attempts for that import.

### Webhook Mentions & Quoted Authors ([#888](https://github.com/aldinokemal/go-whatsapp-web-multidevice/pull/888))

- Include `mentions` and `replied_to_sender` when available, with `mentions_lid` and `replied_to_sender_lid` where applicable.

### Chatwoot Event Filtering & Message Revocation ([#974](https://github.com/aldinokemal/go-whatsapp-web-multidevice/pull/974), [#900](https://github.com/aldinokemal/go-whatsapp-web-multidevice/pull/900))

- Use `CHATWOOT_EVENTS` to select events forwarded to Chatwoot independently of webhook event selection.
- Enable `CHATWOOT_REVOKE_ON_DELETE=true` to revoke linked outbound WhatsApp messages when an agent deletes their Chatwoot message, including messages sent as multiple attachments.

---

## 🐛 Bug Fixes

### Lower Memory Use & Correct Media Extensions ([#874](https://github.com/aldinokemal/go-whatsapp-web-multidevice/pull/874), [#898](https://github.com/aldinokemal/go-whatsapp-web-multidevice/pull/898))

- Stream received media downloads to disk to avoid buffering the entire file in memory.
- Set default MIME types when rebuilding stored media so downloads can retain a file extension.

### Read and Played Receipts From Linked Devices ([#865](https://github.com/aldinokemal/go-whatsapp-web-multidevice/pull/865))

- Forward eligible read and played receipts from a contact's linked devices to webhooks.

### Chatwoot History, Polls & Delivery ([#822](https://github.com/aldinokemal/go-whatsapp-web-multidevice/pull/822), [#973](https://github.com/aldinokemal/go-whatsapp-web-multidevice/pull/973), [#972](https://github.com/aldinokemal/go-whatsapp-web-multidevice/pull/972), [#912](https://github.com/aldinokemal/go-whatsapp-web-multidevice/pull/912))

- Avoid reopening resolved conversations during history sync when there are no new messages to import.
- Keep individual poll votes out of Chatwoot conversations while still forwarding them to webhooks.
- Start Chatwoot forwarding before webhook delivery so retries at a webhook endpoint do not delay Chatwoot forwarding.
- Send Chatwoot API credentials in the hyphenated `api-access-token` header so requests work through proxies that discard heade
